title: EXPERIMENTAL: TWO MORE SWITCHES (RAID DIRECTOR, AIR STRIKE)
why: The experimental page gets the raid director and the air strike, on by default and read when the raid starts. Off, the wave clock runs at its fixed rate with no breather and no ambush pack (the director keeps counting waves, so the 3 waves goal still works) and packs may land on an extraction ring; the air strike has no meter, G does nothing, the bumper chord keeps the belt and zoom, player 2 charges nothing and the air strike goal leaves the goal pool.
now: The experimental page switches the raid director and the air strike.
